reviews.text: Very helpful and friendly

I went in for the first time with my cockapoo who had done something to her hind leg and was clearly in pain. They registered her quickly and a vet saw her almost immediately, diagnosed the problem and sorted out the problem there and then. We were in and out of the vets within 15 mins. Both my dog and I were very happy!

Thanks Henry . Humphrey is not always an easy patient. However you put him at ease and he responded so well . Thanks for being so understanding and taking the time to explain every option available. We are very grateful.
Good all good thanks 🙏
Vet was very kind & took the time to listen to our questions . We were very happy.

Saw my cat same day and were kind and helpful.
All home and happy now.

Our dog Alfred died on 21 August 2026 in specialist intensive care because of toxicity caused by an overdose of the wrong chemotherapy drug administered by Medivet Richmond on 17 August 2026.
We brought our lovely Alfred to Medivet Richmond for his scheduled vinblastine chemotherapy. Instead, he was administered vincristine. Medivet subsequently acknowledged the wrong-drug administration and overdose. Alfred was transferred to specialist intensive care, where he became critically ill and died four days later.
For seven months, Alfred fought with incredible bravery while we prioritised his health above everything else in our lives. All of that non-stop effort, hope and the positive results we had seen were stripped away in an instant, along with his life. We had trusted this practice to have the experience and systems required to administer his chemotherapy safely. We later discovered that a fundamental safeguard - a final independent check of the drug identity before administration - was not in place.
Through the clinic’s own review, we also learned that vincristine and vinblastine had been stored in the same cytotoxic medication area. Furthermore, no chemotherapy consent form was presented to us or signed on the day of treatment.
Medication-selection errors are well-known risks and are precisely the kind of errors that robust checking procedures, appropriate storage arrangements and careful clinical processes are intended to prevent. Learning afterwards that these safeguards were not in place at Medivet Richmond has been extremely distressing.
We deeply regret trusting this practice with the care of our lovely, sweet boy. We have formally raised the matter with the RCVS and are allowing that process to take its course.

Lovely clinic, but they recently  stopped   to claim the insurance directly, despite our petplan insurance, which is very expensive at 180 per month, allows this facility. This is very unconvenient.. i still love  the clinic, which is amazing, but is something important to be considered, particularly because they dont do the claim, that will allow us to be refunded, in one day or so..

Our cat passed somewhere away from home and some angelic people brought his body to Medivet Richmond. The team here were amazingly supportive, sympathetic and caring. Their patience and understanding really helped and we have his ashes and a poor print back home with us. Thank you 🙏 💚 …

I have never felt so angry, heartbroken and let down by a veterinary service in my life.

I took my 15-year-old dog to the emergency clinic in Richmond because she was clearly very unwell. Her eyes were rolling, she was stumbling all over the place and, at one point, she was barely able to walk. I was absolutely terrified. She is an elderly dog who means the world to me, and I went there expecting compassion, urgency and, most importantly, help.

Instead, the experience was incredibly upsetting.

I also have to say that the behaviour and manner of the doctor concerned us so much that we genuinely felt that they may have been under the influence of something. I cannot say that this was definitely the case, but their behaviour and the way they conducted themselves left us extremely uncomfortable and concerned. In an emergency situation involving a 15-year-old dog who could barely walk, this was deeply distressing.

The service we received was, in our experience, rude, cold and completely lacking in compassion. We felt that we were treated as though we were nothing more than a debit card rather than frightened owners desperately trying to get help for a beloved member of our family.

We were told that we supposedly owed several thousand pounds and were described as “bad debtors.” We were shocked and extremely upset by this. We ultimately left and paid £130 for a service that, from our perspective, we simply did not receive.

What makes this even more upsetting is what happened afterwards.

We took our dog to the vet we are registered with — another location of the SAME veterinary group. They checked the situation and told us that there was no debt whatsoever. No thousands of pounds outstanding. No “bad debtor” situation. Nothing.

Unlike our experience in Richmond, the other clinic actually listened to us, treated us with compassion and, most importantly, helped our dog.

I am still incredibly angry and upset when I think about what happened. When someone brings a 15-year-old dog to an emergency clinic who is stumbling, unable to walk properly and clearly displaying frightening symptoms, the last thing they should have to worry about is being made to feel like a financial problem rather than a human being asking for help.

We were frightened. We were desperate. We needed veterinary care.

Instead, we left feeling completely abandoned and humiliated — and £130 out of pocket for what we feel was no meaningful service.

I sincerely hope the management investigates what happened, particularly the conflicting information about the alleged debt, the conduct of the doctor, and the way we were treated.

People bring their beloved animals to emergency vets at some of the most frightening moments of their lives. Compassion, dignity, professionalism and basic humanity should not be optional.
Beautiful service. Thank you

Now I was treated with kindness and professionalism however I have to leave a one star review due to the repeated failures taken place by this establishment in relation to my cat crystal. I took him to this vet as he was suffering from bad dental issues preventing him from eating, when I took him to this practice they repeatedly prescribed medication until eventually they booked a CT scan and a teeth cleaning/removal.

After the procedure took place they told me no removals were necessary and that they couldn’t figure out what was wrong with him. They said to me I needed either, a specialist or I need to consider options to relieve his suffering. I mean the entire veterinary team couldn’t figure out what was wrong with him and I had spent over a thousand pounds at this point. I took him to another vet, and the one person that was there was able to find out that he had tooth resorption and an exposed root. Now my cat can finally yawn and eat again.

I mainly leave this review due to the really disappointing experience here and the fact that my cat could have died due to the repeated missed opportunities to see what was actually wrong.

Maybe consider going to a local veterinary practice  instead of Medivet.

Thanks for the help in caring for our beloved Dog Rick on his last moments.
It was not meant to be, but very grateful for all the efforts. 🐾🐾

The best!!!! They helped a fox we found by the road hit by a car (when everyone else was closed), so can get him to a wildlife hospital the next day. The nurse in particular was the kindest and most knowledgeable woman ever! I cannot recommend this practice enough! Will be bringing our pets here too.
Quick and friendly service. The price for the consultation and medication was fine. Prices quoted for X-rays and CT scan not at all reasonable.
Thank you very much for friendly and welcoming visit. It was my first visit in Medivet and I already feel safe. Kind regard . Parima

Hi everyone,
I took my boss's dog to the emergency vet at Medivet in Richmond because they're open 24/7, and it was a Sunday.

I paid the full bill there, but when I later went back to Medivet in Roehampton, their system showed that there was still money outstanding. This is the second time this has happened.

I had to postpone my work to find proof of payment through my receipts, and then wait for my boss, who is currently on holiday, to send his receipt as well.

Because of the lack of professionalism and the time they made me waste, I spoke to the receptionist in a firm and direct manner. Apparently, I hurt her feelings, and then someone from the Richmond staff called me. They told me that they are allowed to make mistakes and charge whatever they want, but that I wasn't allowed to speak to their staff in that tone.

They then told me to find another veterinary practice, even though I've been with Medivet for 10 years.

Do you think this is fair and professional?

Review for Dr. Stefania Nalon

I would like to thank Dr. Stefania Nalon for the incredible compassion, empathy, and dedication she showed while caring for my beloved dog Isa , during the Night Shift, and all the rest of the team before she passed away on 7th March 2026.

From the very beginning, Dr. Nalon treated Isa with kindness and dignity, and she did absolutely everything within her power to try to save her. Knowing that every possible effort was made brings me comfort during such a painful loss.

It’s taken me a long time to write this review because the grief has been overwhelming, but I wanted to express how deeply grateful I am for the care, professionalism, and genuine compassion she showed to both Isa and me. Thank you for everything—you will always have my gratitude.

We came in on a Saturday evening with our cavapoochon, Brownie, who was very agitated after playing in the garden and coming in with red swelling on his belly.

Lauren and the team diagnosed Brownie with a bee sting and treated him in under 5 minutes. They insisted on not charging us.
We are so grateful to you all for your kindness 🙏

Alba first class caring and professional Vet.
Highly recommend.

fantastic vets. Vet Dr Alba has been a fantastic vet to our dog for the last 14 years. Calm, honest and professional with compassion. highly recommend Medivet. the emergency out of hours vet nurses are fantastic and empathetic too.

shockingly bad communications, billed us over 50% more than the estimate they gave us with zero heads up about this fact or regular updates to discuss the care of our pet. Our cat left hospital after 2 days, multiple tests and a scan later, with no clear diagnosis. I'd rather drive hours absolute anywhere else than deal with this practice again! Shocking.
Friendly reception, on time appointment. The vet was very approachable and kind, my dog responded very well. Gave good advice and no hard sell for services.
Informative and helpful. Thank you for the free dental check for my cat.
Friendly practice and always attentive vets, despite being very busy

Despite not being registered at this vet practice they promptly saw me and my pet as an emergency without any issues. It is very reassuring to know that they are so accessible when your pet has a problem. It’s a very stressful time when your pet is sick and knowing they are there to help calms the situation. All the staff and particularly the on call vet were outstanding in their care and empathy despite clearly being so very busy. I am a doctor so I know how pressurised A&E becomes and yet the atmosphere and consultation was calm and supportive. I highly recommend this vet practice and would attend again if needed.

They were super kind to us when we lost our cat. It was a really hard time but I will never forget how softly each interaction happened, I was grateful the staff just doing their job didn't treat my loss as just a job.

I brought my cat here who unfortunately was already deceased when I found her. The whole team were so lovely and professional, but I have to give a shoutout to Charley. Throughout the whole process she has been so kind and supportive, and you can tell just by talking to her how much she loves animals. She got me through a really difficult period and I will forever be grateful for everything she has done for me.
At Medivet Richmond they make you feel your pet is in good hands and very well taken care of. Staff are very friendly.

They saved my dog’s life, and for that I will be eternally grateful. The care, skill, and compassion shown by the entire team were truly exceptional. I will always recommend this hospital without hesitation. The treatment is expensive, and I only wish this level of outstanding care was accessible to everyone. Thank you.
Excellent - able to cope with our stressed and anxious rescue Doberman, Bo. Expensive but worth it and open 24/7 for all the out of hours illnesses she's had over the years... Thank you!

I’ve been out of the country and my chow chow got heatstroke on Friday… they took him and released him yesterday (sunday) I called once at night to check in as I was halfway around the world and the nurse gave me attitude “I don’t know how he is cause I’m busy answering you” anyway I had to call for updates during the day and they said that he’s doing much better and can be released. I asked if he needed any follow up appointments and the vet specifically said no. Anyways I landed today (Monday morning) ran to my dog and the first thing I noticed was this huge rash all across him that no one in Medivet documented, treated or made me aware…. How was he having 24 hour care and no one noticed this to even let me know…. Comepletely ridiculous… spent nearly £2k btw
My dog was very well looked after, and the staff were very kind and welcoming. The Vet was very nice and answered my all questions. Highly recommend.

Visited Medivet recently with my dog and had a really lovely experience. The staff were all so welcoming, kind and helpful from the moment we arrived. My dog felt calm and comfortable with the doctors, which made the whole visit much easier for both of us. Really grateful for the care and reassurance we received. Highly recommend.

This vet was so helpful when my dog has swallowed a plastic wrapper on a Saturday morning when my usual vet in Whitton was closed. I took him to this vet on an emergency appointment and they managed to treat him and recovered the wrapper that he had swallowed. Lovely helpful staff and so pleased to be back at home with my dog, with the knowledge that he is safe from a potentially more serious issue with his digestive system.
Amazing! Such lovely staff - so good with my nervous cat :)

I visited the clinic on Saturday, 6 June, because I could feel a lump just below my dog's neck. I explained to the vet that I suspected it might be a mass of grass or something trapped in the area. However, I was told that no lump could be felt during the examination.
The following night, my dog vomited a very large amount of grass, which makes me believe that my concerns may not have been investigated thoroughly enough during the visit. While I understand that diagnosing animals can sometimes be difficult, I expected a more careful examination given the symptoms I described.
Unfortunately, I paid £65 for the consultation and left without any answers or treatment, only to discover shortly afterwards what appears to have been the cause of the problem. Based on this experience, I feel the visit could have been more thorough and attentive.
My beloved kitten underwent a surgery and all the staff and post surgery treatment was amazing! Thank you all so much for the care and love you showed my pet and myself!

Medivet isn't my usual vet but was the nearest to me. I had an unwell kitten at night and phoned Medivet Richmond who said they could see me in 30 minutes.  When I arrived, the kitten was triage immediately.  I was called in by the vet shortly afterwards. Steph was very kind and clear and gentle with the kitten and gave me two options. The fees were very reasonable and the kitten made a full recovery.  I was very happy with the service despite it being very busy for the staff.

We cannot thank Eloi enough for everything he did for our puppy.

Another vet told us he had aspiration pneumonia, which was extremely worrying and scary for us. Eloi took the time to properly assess him, explain everything clearly, and reassure us with incredible professionalism and knowledge that this was not actually the case.

What really stood out was not only his skills and expertise, but also how human, kind, and caring he was throughout the whole process. You can genuinely see how much he loves dogs and truly cares about their health and wellbeing. He made us feel listened to, supported, and much calmer during a very stressful moment.

An amazing vet and an amazing person. We are so grateful and would highly recommend Eloi to anyone looking for someone who is knowledgeable, honest, compassionate, and exceptional at what he does.

Shocking rip off . Sold me meds that I could get on line and even from super drug etc. for 4 x the price.  12 min consultation cost £70.  No wonder more vets are openning to challenge their high street domination.   I know I’m Not the only person who feels this way.

Had to take my cat here for an urgent appointment we called in the morning and managed to get a same day appointment later in the afternoon. Process couldn’t have been more smooth. Receptionist and Vet Clara were all lovely and I’m very reassured couldn’t be more grateful. Thank you x

Traumatic experience and unprofessional care for my cat.
Extremely dissatisfied with the treatment of my cat, Steve. He was subjected to excessive physical distress, including five forceful thermometer attempts that resulted in rectal bleeding, which the vet dismissed as "normal." Despite my explicit and repeated requests for a blood test due to fox exposure and zoonotic concerns (Toxoplasmosis/Bartonella), the vet was unfamiliar with these diseases and eventually returned Steve after 40 minutes with his neck sheared and nicked, but no blood test performed. We left with no diagnostics, no fluids for his dehydration, and a treatment plan of force-feeding probiotics to a traumatised, reactive cat. Steve is now weaker and more distressed than before the visit. I will not recommend this clinic at all, the receptionist are really nice but their vet Gemma is unprofessional, lack knowledge and sensitivity expected from a vet. Do not recommend this clinic.
Excellent service. It would be nice to be offered an itemised receipt, rather than just just being told the full amount

A big thank you to Medivet Richmond for taking excellent care of my dog, Jessie, who needed hospitalisation for 2 days.  She is back home and on the mend.    I don't know all the names of the vets, nurses and other staff, including receptionists, who took care of her and were helpful and compassionate when communicating with me - here are some: Billy, Emma, Stefania and Jessie.  You are all very much appreciated.
They were so helpful when my cat was rushed in with CHF. They have given me more time with her they saved her life.
Did everything they could to look after our dog in an emergency.

ANIMAL ❌😵

My past cat and bunny were serviced here. putting my cat down here was a terror. They gave us such a hard time and it was a fight to even get the ashes off of them. didn’t think asking for my own cats burnt self was such a terrible thing to ask. I got my cat dust in the end. (My cat was 20 years old)💨 then I made the terrible mistake of putting my 14 year old bunny down there this was disgusting. I took my bunny there and they didn’t even put her down when they said they were going to. We were told 3 days later that they only then put her down and lied to us. Then again was a fight to get ashes or anything of her to take back home with us. Then again got my bun dust in the end (just a joke to lighten the mood love the buns)  Will not be going there again do your pets a favour and go to medivet Barnes.

Animal rights? More like animal frights.

Brought my toy poodle for a annual vaccination. Dr Henry is very knowledgeable and explains everything very well. The receptionist lady (Forgot to ask her name) is really helpful. I believe everyone did their job very well.
Thank you for rating us. Your feedback is really appreciated.
Very good service, easy to get emergency appointment. All options given and affordable.

Super friendly and caring.
Don’t over charge or treat for unnecessary things. No upselling

Have used Medivet Mortlake for many years.Alba who is my main vet has helped get us through some terrible times with very sick animals.Trish the night nurse who is an absolute credit to Medivet as no matter what time of the night I have called she has always been so caring and compassionate.
A big thank you to ALL the other vets who have been there for all my animals over the years.I would not trust any other vet in London apart from this practice.
Cannot forget the many nurses out the back of the practice for the care they have also given to my animals.

Carry on the great work Medivet Mortlake

Excellent Team! Best Vet ever!
Medivet Richmond saved our Cat .
All animals in best hands.

We are incredibly grateful to the whole team at Medivet Richmond for their kindness, care, and support throughout our cat Cookie’s journey.

From the moment Cookie was diagnosed, through the referral to specialist care, and all the way to her final days, the Medivet team surrounded us with unwavering support and compassion. During such a difficult time, their patience, understanding, and genuine kindness meant more to us than words can express.

A special thank you to Dr. Billy and Dr. Clara for their dedication, kindness, and support — we will always remember it.

Their professionalism and heartfelt care made a truly difficult journey more bearable, and we always felt that Cookie was treated with dignity, gentleness, and love.

Thank you for everything you have done for Cookie and for standing by us every step of the way. She will always be remembered, and so will your kindness.

Emergency visit on Bank Holiday so a bit stressful and pricey, but the staff and vets were very kind and caring. It’s good to know the service is available when our usual vets is closed. Thanks for caring for Blanka
Thank you for your review. Your rating is really appreciated.
Excellent care given to my dog
Thank you Stefania, Davina, Paula, James, and the whole team for taking such wonderful care of Phoebe during her emergency stay last weekend. I’m incredibly grateful to you all. 🐾 …

It’s taken me a good while to write this review and get over the experience with Medivet Richmond. I was with Medivet Acton and found them caring and animal focused so when an emergency out of hours arose I chose to go with Medivet Richmond, sadly that was the worst choice I have ever made. My older cat showed symptoms as previously with UTI which had twice before been treated successfully and quickly. I called and was told I would need to agree payment of £160 before I could secure an emergency appointment, on arrival the vet was adamant that my cat would need an ultrasound,bloods and overnight stay quoting upwards of £3000, I did not have insurance which I fully own as being completely irresponsible and live with that guilt. I explained I could not afford this and asked if he could be given treatment he had previously had as the symptoms were identical and it’s common in older cats with kidney decline to get multiple UTIs having been explained this by his regular vet. The vet refused saying he could not give these without knowing if this was the case so I had 3 options, take him home and get a urine sample, while he watched my cat scream in pain trying to urinate and passing blood, this would take 3-4 days for results, admit and pay or euthanasia. The whole time he stood and watched my cat in extreme agony trying to urinate and only  passing blood and didn’t flinch. I sadly had to make the hardest decision of my life, I chose to euthanise as I could not afford upwards of 3k. It then got worse, he took my cat to put a canula in, told me to go pay while I waited, I guess the worry being I would walk out in my distress and fail to pay.
He came back, I held my cat and the injection was administered not as had been done before with my previous 20 year old cat at a different surgery , slowly and with care but forced in so quickly making my animal scream and lodge his claws in my face, then just dead, not a slow going to sleep. I sat and said goodbye for a period, the guilt and sadness was overwhelming. This was not how things should end after 17 years,  I failed him. When it was time to go, this man again showed no compassion, I went to hand my cat to him and was met with’ just put it on the table’
I understand that vets see people with no insurance as irresponsible but to have no spark of compassion or care for a suffering animal that your profession is there for is beyond comprehension. The vet in question was I believe called Dimitri and I would warn anyone to think twice before using Medivet Richmond, I can’t imagine all the vets there are as callous but in an emergency I would definitely call elsewhere.

Thank you to the kind staff who put our family dog to sleep, my mum and dad had no money and the dog was so poorly, if it wasn’t for your kindness you showed them Ruby would have suffered, thank you sooo much.

I would never recommend Medivet Richmond based on my recent experience.

My dog’s treatment was delayed due to repeated prescription errors, which the practice later acknowledged were made internally. Despite this, I was asked to pay again for corrected prescriptions that were only required because of those errors.

Even more concerning, I was told that my dog’s medication would not be released unless I paid a separate, disputed charge relating to a different pet, which was raised more than five months after the original appointment. I was later advised that this charge arose due to an internal administrative error, as the correct items had not been processed at the time of the original visit.

This placed my dog’s health at risk and caused significant distress. Transparency around billing was poor, and resolving the situation required extensive chasing and escalation. When it comes to animal healthcare, accuracy, accountability, and prioritising the patient should come first.

Sadly, that was not my experience here.

The Staff at Lower Richmond Practice are Very Friendly, Helpful, Supportive and Professional.
I would Definitely Recommend you bring your Fur Babies here 🐕🐈🐁🐇 …

Exceptional care and professionalism from the emergency night staff. We were gently guided through an incredibly difficult experience to a peaceful conclusion for our beautiful cat. Thank you to Charlie for her kindness and compassion - the paw prints and fur clippings are irreplaceable. xx

We can't thank you enough for the tremendous care you gave to our beloved cat, Pudsey. We will always remember your kindness and compassion at one of the most difficult times. I highly recommend your practice.
fantastic so friendly so professional great experience
God sent replacement for absent RSPCA.

Excellent care & service. Our Jack Russell became sick on a Saturday afternoon. We called the vet and were told we could come at once. The receptionist was friendly, we waited just a few minutes and saw the vet. He was precessional and efficient, giving us his clear diagnoses and administering an anti-emetic. The following day he seemed much brighter, back to his normal chippy self (the dog, not the vet!) Thanks for excellent advice and care. There are parking places on the pavement beside the surgery.

What a remarkable facility... intense one to one care... human hospitals would do well to follow a similar model

Thank you xXx
Alba is an amazing Vet. I moved to London 1 year ago and I was concerned to find a vet I like. But know I’m very happy that my girls are on good hands.

I would like to recommend this veterinary clinic from the bottom of my heart. This is without any doubt the best experience I have ever had with any veterinary clinic in my life. They saved the life of my girl and her puppies, all of them, during Boxing Day, in the Christmas holidays. Every single member of staff deserves the highest praise, from the receptionist to the nurses and the vets. The level of empathy, kindness, professionalism and genuine care shown throughout was truly exceptional. At every stage, I felt that my family and our animals were treated with respect, compassion and real concern, not as just another case. Special thanks go to the vet who was looking after Molly. His dedication, knowledge and calm, caring approach literally saved her life. I will be forever grateful for what he did. I cannot thank this clinic enough. If anyone is looking for a place where animals receive outstanding medical care and people are treated with warmth, empathy and humanity, this is the clinic to choose. I recommend them with complete confidence.

Dr. Alba is an amazing specialist! She’s friendly, caring, and very knowledgeable. My dog isn’t usually happy about any treatments, but Alba managed to find an approach that made the experience comfortable for both my dog and me:)

I am incredibly grateful to the veterinary team for the compassion and kindness they showed during one of the hardest moments of my life. They treated my dog with dignity, patience, and genuine care, and they made a heartbreaking decision feel as peaceful and loving as possible. The veterinarian took the time to explain everything, answered my questions with empathy, and never rushed us. I will always appreciate the warmth and professionalism they showed, and I’m thankful my dog’s final moments were handled with such gentleness and respect.
A great practice with a friendly team.
Thank you for your review. Your rating is really appreciated.
Took my 9 weeks puppy to Medivet. They were absolutely excellent. Truly care about the wellbeing of animals
Excellent service. Friendly staff who clearly care about animals and their owners

We brought our 5-day-old newborn kitten to Medivet Richmond in a very critical condition after aspiration pneumonia. His breathing was extremely fast and weak, and we were prepared for the worst.

The whole team here was incredibly gentle, caring and calm. They placed him in oxygen immediately, monitored him throughout the night, kept us updated and treated him as if he was their own little baby. Thanks to their professional care, his breathing became stable, his temperature rose back to normal, and today he even started suckling again, something we honestly didn’t expect to happen so soon.

We are extremely grateful for the honesty, the communication, and the dedication from both the nurses and the vet. Our kitten would not have survived without their immediate help. Thank you for giving him a chance.

Highly recommend this Medivet branch for emergency and newborn care.

Beware of this Medivet Richmonds unethical practices.

I’ve had multiple extremely negative experiences with Medivet — from misdiagnosis, carelessness and missed prescriptions to incorrect insurance claims and complete lack of accountability. It became clear very quickly that this clinic prioritizes profit over the welfare of the animals they are supposed to care for.

When my dog suffered a seizure, Medivet immediately suggested it was likely a brain tumour and pushed a £4,500 MRI scan. I declined and sought a second opinion elsewhere, only to discover the seizure was caused by a B12 deficiency — something Medivet should have identified from the £180 blood tests they ran that same day and cost me £20 to treat with a few additional supplements to his diet.

Their administrative failures are just as concerning. They have a ridiculous turnover of staff which may explain why they failed to submit an insurance claim for six months due to “lack of staff,” then tried to make me pay it myself. When challenged, they finally sent the claim through — but for the *wrong condition*, leaving over £1,000 unpaid. Despite this being entirely their error, they have repeatedly threatened me with credit control and debt collection even when my dog passed away, it was the most disturbing traumatic experience and they even tried to bring it up when I collected her ashes in tears!

I’ve asked for a partner or branch manager to contact me more than four times in writing and once vets in person over the past year which legally I am entitled to… No one has ever bothered to reach out. The most disturbing incident came recently: this prior outstanding balance (again, caused by their incorrect claim form) was for a pet who has since passed away. When I had to bring another dog in for urgent care last week the vet refused to see him until I paid a £59 consultation fee upfront — even while he was screaming in pain because and I quote ‘you have an outstanding balance on file’.

To make matters worse, I received an aggressive, dismissive phone call from a receptionist today demanding payment and threatening credit control once again, with no interest whatsoever in hearing the context or acknowledging Medivet’s mistakes. She was rude and her tone was very unkind and sarcastic and once I tried to explain all the errors and request yet again a manager or partner ring me she said ok bye!

It is appalling to see a place that should prioritize animal care behaving like a profit-driven debt-collection operation. Based on my experience, I strongly advise anyone seeking genuine, compassionate veterinary care to look elsewhere because Medivet Richmond do not care and there are far better vets who truly care about your pet’s wellbeing not just lining their pockets and upselling their services rather than treating the animals in the kindest most efficient way rather than subjecting them to unnecessary tests and scans.
The vet (the doctor) was really kind and helpful and seemingly knowledgeable but the rest of the staff especially the girl in the reception was awfully rude, they treated us terribly.

We recently moved to this practice from another branch in the same chain after being really impressed with the care they gave our cat Monty. About six months ago he was rushed in with anaphylaxis and every vet we saw was brilliant. They acted quickly, explained everything clearly and I’m sure their fast response saved his life.

There were a few complications afterwards but the team handled everything really well. Everyone we dealt with was professional, kind and reassuring. We’ve just been back for Monty’s six month check up and saw a new vet, Henry, who was absolutely excellent. He took his time with Monty, gave him a very thorough examination and explained everything in a clear and calm way. He was gentle, professional and you could tell he genuinely cared. It’s always reassuring when a vet takes that much care and attention, and Monty was completely relaxed with him. Monty got a clean bill of health which we’re so pleased about.

The reception staff are always friendly and welcoming too. We honestly can’t fault this practice. It’s a shame to see a few negative reviews as being a 24 hour hospital they probably deal with the tougher and more expensive emergency cases. From our experience they’ve been caring, skilled and completely professional. We’re very grateful for everything they’ve done for Monty.

They saved my cat's life. He ate a one metre long elastic string on a Sunday morning, which could be deadly.
They told me to go immediately, advised on options and allowed me to take an informed decision.  Their prompt action avoided the most dreadful consequences. I can't recommend them enough.
Nikiana is great and such a caring vet. everyone is very nice and helpful

Heartbreaking Experience – My Dog’s Life Was Taken Away at Medivet Richmond

I am writing this with a broken heart after losing my beloved dog, Mia, and her puppies following a visit to Medivet Richmond. Mia had a healthy labour and was caring for her five pups beautifully. Two days later, she suddenly became weak a common issue in small breeds after giving birth due to low calcium.

I rushed her to Medivet Richmond, explained the situation, and shared the advice I’d received from another vet, but the staff dismissed everything I said. They insisted on running their own expensive tests and soon told me she needed surgery. Despite my concerns that she was a new mum still feeding her pups, they pressured me to agree.

After the surgery, they admitted they found nothing wrong. Mia came home in a terrible state weak, disoriented, and in obvious pain. Within hours, one puppy had died, and the others were fading fast. I called Medivet several times, begging for help, but was told it was “normal.” By the next morning, Mia could hardly breathe. I rushed her back, only to face another large bill and more uncertainty. Not long after, my beautiful girl lost her life.

Her life was taken away from her. She just needed simple, basic help — not unnecessary procedures, pain, and suffering. I truly believe that with proper care and compassion, Mia could still be here today with her babies.

To make things even more painful, just a couple of days later I received an email from Medivet with cremation prices and funeral services. It was heartbreaking — instead of showing care or empathy, it felt like they were focused on business, not on saving lives.

Please, be cautious. Ask questions. Don’t let anyone pressure you into decisions you don’t understand. I never imagined trusting a veterinary clinic could end with such heartbreak. Mia didn’t deserve this!
